question: What was the percentage change in interest income for Nextdc-Ltd between the financial years ending 30 June 2018 and 30 June 2019?
retrieval_query: Nextdc-Ltd interest income percentage change financial year ending 30 June 2018 to 30 June 2019
answer:
Percentage change in interest income = [(Interest income 2019 - Interest income 2018) / Interest income 2018] × 100  
= [(8,220 - 5,778) / 5,778] × 100  
= (2,442 / 5,778) × 100  
= 0.4233 × 100  
= 42.33%

Source: f59bd5ee555e5cc8cf1d5223a0145049.pdf p.1
